plan.notes: Official 'Suggested Course Sequence' from Cabrillo College (Communication Studies- AA-T  - Transfer Pathway to CSUMB). Cabrillo labels this 'a suggested sequence of coursework' and notes 'This is not an official educational plan'; sequenced here as the college's published pathway.
